title: ADARULE: LLM-Driven Natural Language to LTL Conversion via Pattern-Adaptive Rule Induction
summary: The original ADARULE pipeline converts natural-language requirements to LTL formulas via pattern-adaptive rule induction, where an LLM iteratively induces and refines a set of translation rules from examples before applying them to new inputs.
This reproduction replaces the multi-step rule induction pipeline with a direct NL-to-LTL translation prompt over sampled benchmark requirements, evaluated via Spot semantic equivalence.
